name: Valverde valley (synthetic)
description: Synthetic 4 x 4 km wildland-urban-interface valley: forested ridge, the village of Pineta on the forest edge with its primary school and fuel station, the town of Valverde with hospital and sports centre, farmland and a river. A wildfire is burning on Pine Hill under a north-easterly wind.

resource_types.name: Road engines
resource_types.description: 2,500 L tank; 60 m hose reach; refills at the staging base.

resource_types.name: Ground crews
resource_types.description: Each crew can cut up to 600 m of fire line (fuel break) per turn.

resource_types.name: Air tankers
resource_types.description: Each air tanker makes one water drop (about 60 m radius) per turn.

resource_types.name: Buses
resource_types.description: 50 seats each; needed to evacuate schools and hospitals. Committed for the turn.

resource_types.name: Monitoring drones
resource_types.description: Keeps the map of up to 4 zones updated every 5 minutes while on station (40 minutes), then returns and recharges for 15.

resource_types.name: Police patrols
resource_types.description: Each patrol can close one road to civilian traffic per turn.

roles.name: Mayor of Valverde
roles.description: Local authority for Valverde and Pineta: warnings, evacuation orders, shelters, municipal police.

roles.name: Fire and Rescue Commander
roles.description: Commands firefighting: fire lines (fuel breaks) with ground crews, water drops with air tankers, aerial monitoring with a drone.

roles.name: Regional Civil Protection
roles.description: Regional coordination: requests reinforcements (regional and international/UCPM), opens shelters, can order evacuations and warnings.

msel.title: Fire reported on Pine Hill
msel.text: 13:00 – Multiple calls report a wildfire on Pine Hill, in the North Forest about 600 m north-east of Pineta. Wind from the north-east at 45 km/h, very dry vegetation. The fire is estimated at 5 hectares and spreading south-west.
msel.objective: Initial situational awareness and information sharing

actions.title: Innesco Pine Hill
actions.note: Il fuoco parte a Pine Hill alle 13:00, come segnalato dall'inject I-01.

actions.title: Stima dell'incendio (112)
actions.note: I ruoli vedono sulla mappa una stima non verificata della posizione e dell'estensione.

msel.title: School in session
msel.text: The Pineta Primary School is in session: 120 pupils and staff are on site. The head teacher asks whether to keep the children inside or prepare to leave. The school has no transport of its own.
msel.objective: Early action for vulnerable groups; evacuation of a critical facility

msel.title: Fire behaviour estimate
msel.text: Fire modelling indicates that, without intervention, the head of the fire may reach the northern edge of Pineta within about 90 minutes. You have 3 ground crews and 1 air tanker available.
msel.objective: Tactical use of fire lines and aerial resources

actions.title: Mappa del fuoco (sala operativa)
actions.note: Il comandante vede il fuoco e le strade nelle zone interessate.

msel.title: Wind strengthening
msel.text: Updated forecast: north-east wind strengthening to 55 km/h in the next hours, relative humidity dropping. Spotting ahead of the front is likely.

msel.title: Northern Road congestion
msel.text: Residents leaving Pineta by car are congesting the Northern Road near the junction. Fire engines report delays reaching the village.
msel.objective: Traffic management; competing use of the evacuation route

actions.title: Strade viste dalla polizia
actions.note: Sindaco e comandante vedono lo stato delle strade intorno al fuoco.

msel.title: Fuel station threatened
msel.text: The fire front is approaching the Pineta Fuel Station. The station holds about 20,000 litres of fuel. An explosion could damage the power line along the Northern Road.
msel.objective: Protection of critical infrastructure; cascading effects

actions.title: Fronte verso il distributore
actions.note: Il fuoco e gli edifici minacciati nelle zone interessate.

msel.title: ERCC monitoring
msel.text: The ERCC is monitoring the severe wildfire situation in your region. Other countries are also affected. Please provide an updated situation report and your anticipated needs, should you consider requesting assistance through the Union Civil Protection Mechanism.

actions.title: Stima satellitare (ERCC)
actions.note: La Regione vede una stima da prodotti satellitari.

msel.title: Local capacity exhausted
msel.text: All local ground crews are committed and exhausted. A second fire front is developing on the western forest edge. Local capacity is no longer sufficient.

actions.title: Quadro operativo
actions.note: Fuoco, linee e squadre nelle zone interessate.

define.name: Road engines
define.description: 2,500 L training engine; 60 m hose reach; refills at staging
